name: Battle Step (Combat)
body:
You’ve studied a flashy, dancelike martial art that incorporates taunts, leaps and amazingly quick and brutal footwork. Your attacks are incredibly flashy, incorporating verbal and spoken taunts and insults, and you are instantly recognizable by your unique combat flourishes and body language.

Prerequisites: flurry of blows class feature, Improved Unarmed Strike, Dodge, base attack bonus +4

Benefit: When using the full attack action, you add your Charisma bonus (if positive) on attack rolls, acrobatics checks, and Reflex saves until the end of your turn.
